name: charm-tracked-unload
summary: Tracked Charm loop particle borrow unloaded while active: warm the Charm target sequence, client Borrow via .catalogex, read back the Sample effects root, remove Sample, read back again, reinstall and confirm protection.
notes: Acceptance procedure — not run. Outstanding check from the 2026-09-07 catalog live audit: charm-loop-particle-borrow explicitCleanup tracked Charm unload while active was not exercised.
This case must run with --side client. The borrow lives on the client; removal unloads Sample on --side.

.catalogex warm is server-side: ctx.Effects.ServerBeamLink(character, character, seconds: 8, sequenceGuid: -541113174). ServerBeam.Link accepts the same character as both endpoints (it only treats endIndex 0 as a one-entity mark), so warm does not spawn a marker rat. The Charm target sequence plays its particles at the player; playing it once makes Part_Charm_Loop_01 resident on the client. Expected log: CATALOGEX warm entity=<handle.Entity> enabled=True. The handle is ctx.Track'd by ServerBeamLink and disposes at its 8 s deadline.

Expected after .catalogex borrow: CATALOGEX borrow enabled=True root=progenitor-effects-progenitor.sample on the client log; charm-root-readback returns CHARMROOT children=1 with the child activeSelf=True and particle systems playing.
Expected after removal: Sample effects root absent or children=0 (tracked handle disposed at unload). Then reinstall; protectionCheck expect true.

IEffectHandle has no position API; ParticleHandle does. The client handler casts to ParticleHandle and sets Position to the local character Translation when that component exists; otherwise the clone stays at the world origin (catalog default).

Event id 0x536D4378 (ASCII SmCx). .catalogex borrow|dispose|status on the server sends Packet{Kind} to the calling user; the client plugin calls ctx.Effects.Borrow. The handle is kept in a static field and is also ctx.Track'd by Borrow, so Core sweep disposes it on Removal. Plugin.OnUnload is not given a Detach line (one-line Plugin.cs budget).

Run this case with --side client only when the test user is already admin on the server (the rig's admin grant then writes the client User view; .catalogex is still a server chat command). Default --side server unloads the server Sample and will not dispose the client clone — in that mode the live job must rename the client reload folder's Progenitor.Sample.dll the same way tools/live-rig/lib/reload.mjs does, then re-run the readback snippet.
Sample [NetworkCompatibility(ServerMustHave, Exact)] may kick the client if the client image is removed while the server image still requires it. Record whether the client stayed connected.
No units are spawned. Cleanup and final checks still run. Do not leave .fx handles live; they share the same Sample root.
